description.text: Startmate backs ANZ's most ambitious founders with $120k, a 14-week Accelerator and mentors who invest. Summer '27 applications close 8 November.

targetApplicants.text: For 15 years we have invested in and supercharged the best founders in ANZ. It doesn't matter where you are on your founder journey - aspiring or proven - Startmate's DNA is giving founders an unfair advantage.
